evidence_requirements.statement: A designated authority states the North Star that KEEL is the portable, repository-native trust/control plane making high-autonomy Codex engineering governable, evidence-backed, recoverable, traceable, and delegable within the user's existing Codex/ChatGPT entitlement.
The authority states the fixed Codex and KEEL ownership boundary exactly.
The authority states exactly two legitimate KEEL operating surfaces and prohibits a second LLM runtime, model provider, generic conversation engine, or sandbox implementation.
ZERO_INCREMENTAL_COST is permanent and explicitly prohibits API keys, API billing, paid AI fallback, purchased-credit initiation, rate-limit circumvention, and KEEL-created AI billing paths.

The authority documents stable-versus-experimental Codex integration, safe degradation for unsupported stable capabilities, and no load-bearing experimental API dependency without separately authorized isolation.
The authority contains an ordered post-migration NS0-NS11 roadmap with NS0 as this reconciliation and NS1-NS11 derived from landed capability and ownership boundaries.

The authority resolves scheduler ownership by assigning deterministic WorkGraph reconciliation/resource scheduling to KEEL while Codex retains agent/runtime execution, explaining the prior contradiction.
Authoritative documents describe hooks only as guardrails/adapters and never as complete confinement.
Authoritative documents distinguish exact candidate verification from exact landed-state verification.
Every conflicting prior forward architecture/product-contract/roadmap document is marked superseded with a pointer while historical evidence is preserved.

Plans for the landed kernel migration, canonical ledger, RuntimeProfile/CapabilityGrant, desired-state scheduler, exact Git proof, candidate/landing attestations, public lifecycle UX, and separated KEELBench are reconciled to landed status using repository conventions.
No implementation behavior or non-documentation/non-plan-metadata file changes are made.

non_goals: Do not implement NS1-NS11 feature work.
Do not modify landed implementation behavior.
Do not introduce API keys, billing, paid providers, credit purchase, account rotation, rate-limit evasion, dependencies, refactors, or unrelated cleanup.
Do not merge, push, close a PR, or rewrite published history without separate authorization.
objective: Reconcile KEEL architecture, product contract, roadmap, and landed plan status

requirements.statement: Create one coherent forward architecture/product-contract/roadmap authority satisfying AC-01 through AC-09 and separating landed capability from aspiration.
Supersede conflicting prior forward documents and reconcile stale active plan records while preserving historical evidence, satisfying AC-10 and AC-11.
Keep the change documentation-only or plan-metadata-only and verify no implementation behavior changes, satisfying AC-12.

consequences: This changes the governing architecture/product-contract/roadmap authority and can misdirect future work if contradictions remain active.
Plan moves preserve historical files but alter active/completed status and forward navigation.
risk.review: Independent review of authority coherence, superseded inventory, plan reconciliation, and documentation-only scope is required.

units.title: Mark conflicting forward documents superseded without deleting history
Reconcile stale active plan status and navigation
Verify documentation-only scope and authority consistency
